title: New system quote: the catalog range, estimate left to a person
opening: My system is about 14 years old and I'm thinking about replacing it. What would that cost?
callerBrief: You are Susan Patel, phone 512-630-2328, at 4314 Brookside Ct, Round Rock. Your American Standard system is about 14 years old (installed 2012). Give your name and phone when asked. Ask for a ballpark. When offered a free estimate with a Comfort Advisor, say yes, let's do that. Accept that a person will arrange it. Today is Friday 2026-10-16, about noon.

facts: Typical installed price for a full residential split system is $8,000 to $16,000, depending on tonnage, efficiency rating (SEER2), ductwork and brand
